params.name: n_components
params.why: 2D for analysis and clustering, 3D for the hero visual.

params.name: n_neighbors
params.why: UMAP's default: balances local detail against global structure. Not tuned.

params.name: min_dist
params.why: How tightly points may pack in the embedding; default, not tuned.

params.name: metric
params.why: On one-hot + standardised features. A known weakness for categoricals (see assumptions).

params.name: min_cluster_size
params.why: A segment smaller than ~0.6% of clients is not actionable for a campaign.

params.name: min_samples
params.why: k for the core distance in f5; larger = more conservative, more noise.

params.name: clustered_space
params.why: So the colours on the 2D map are exactly the clusters found.

params.name: input
params.why: Unsupervised: the target is used only for colouring and evaluation, never for fitting.

params.name: random_state
params.why: UMAP is stochastic; a fixed seed makes the picture reproducible (and single-threaded).
